title: The Panel Information Matrix Test
abstract: arXiv:2610.12350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Information Matrix (IM) test is a natural specification check for likelihood-based models, yet cross-sectional implementations are often badly sized, confound neglected heterogeneity with distributional misspecification, and require third derivatives. We develop the panel information matrix (PIM) test for models with fixed effects. Explicit fixed effects isolate functional-form misspecification from time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity. Although the profile maximum likelihood estimator inherits incidental-parameter bias of order $O(1/T)$, the leading bias of the profile PIM is of order $\sqrt{n}/T$, so it is asymptotically negligible whenever $n/T^2\to 0$, which includes the rectangular regime $n/T\to\mathrm{const}$, and stabilizes under parabolic asymptotics $n/T^2\to\rho\in(0,\infty)$. This robustness arises because the indicator fluctuates at rate $\sqrt{n}$ rather than $\sqrt{nT}$. The same rate argument makes third-derivative

translated_abstract: 信息矩阵（IM）检验是基于似然模型的一种自然的设定检验，但其在横截面数据中的实现往往存在严重的检验水平扭曲，会把被忽略的异质性与分布误设混为一谈，并且需要计算三阶导数。我们针对固定效应模型开发了面板信息矩阵（PIM）检验。显式引入的固定效应能够将函数形式误设与时不变的不可观测异质性分离开来。尽管剖面极大似然估计量继承了 O(1/T) 阶的伴随参数偏误，但剖面 PIM 统计量的主导偏误为 √n/T 阶，因此只要 n/T² → 0，该偏误在渐近意义上便可忽略——这包括 n/T → 常数的矩形渐近情形，并且在 n/T² → ρ ∈ (0,∞) 的抛物线渐近下依然保持稳定。这种稳健性源于该指标以 √n 而非 √(nT) 的速率波动。同样的速率论证也使得三阶导数……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了针对固定效应面板模型的面板信息矩阵（PIM）检验，通过显式固定效应分离函数形式误设与不可观测的个体异质性，并证明该检验统计量的主导伴随参数偏误仅为 √n/T 阶，故在 n/T² → 0 的渐近条件下（包括矩形渐近）无需偏误修正即可保持稳健。
en_tdlr: The paper develops the Panel Information Matrix (PIM) test for fixed-effects panel models, which explicitly separates functional-form misspecification from time-invariant unobserved heterogeneity, and shows its leading incidental-parameter bias is of order √n/T, making the test asymptotically robust whenever n/T² → 0, including the rectangular regime.
